title: routers/report_export.py — GET /reports/sales/export + GET /reports/inward/export (StreamingResponse)
scope: FastAPI router with prefix='/reports', tags=['reports']. Two GET endpoints: /sales/export?format=pdf|xlsx (required query param, multi-value date/dealer/place/design filters); /inward/export?format=pdf|xlsx (same pattern with supplier_ids). Both: delegate to ReportExportService, wrap returned (BytesIO, content_type, filename) tuple in StreamingResponse with Content-Disposition attachment header. Auth: get_current_user at route level (any role). No response_model (binary response).

success_criteria.definition_of_done: report_export.py with 2 routes. StreamingResponse returned. Content-Disposition attachment set. Auth required. 400 on bad format handled by ReportExportService layer.
